features.name: War Priest
features.desc: As a Bonus Action, you grant yourself or a creature within 30 feet one weapon attack. A number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus (per Long Rest).

features.name: War God's Blessing
features.desc: As a Reaction, you give +10 to an attack roll made by you or an ally within 30 feet (expends Channel Divinity).

features.name: Avatar of Battle
features.desc: You gain Resistance to nonmagical Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
